Judged correct.
- The fix, read line by line: the collapse arm used to require `strippedNewlines === 0` and read the RAW sent text — a deliberate refusal of a then-unmeasured cell — so a body that sent both a trailing newline and the blank line above its rule (`\n\n\n---…\n`, what every `--body` write of a seat post sends) came back `mutated` and exit 4 when the platform stored the block's own `\n\n---…`. The arm now reads the TRIMMED body, so ONE arm covers the collapse alone and the collapse over the strip, the strip count recorded on the verdict and named on the line (「over 1 stripped trailing newline(s)」); the comparison stays an exact `===` against a candidate BUILT from the sent bytes, the head compared literally. The seat's two mechanism assumptions were refined by measurement, correctly: the collapse ALONE was already clean on `origin/main` (the seat's claim conflated the two acts), and there is no separate `--comment` classifier to share — since #18693 one predicate judges both acts, the comment writes passed on their BYTES (the `re-anchored` shape), so no second parser was written. Bounded exactly as #19350's close requires: a content byte differing under the same strip-and-collapse still exits 4, a footer RELOCATED (the card's original claim — equal bytes in another position) still exits 4, a multiset compare is refused by pin, two extra blank lines stay an unmeasured cell. Judged correct.
- Evidence, seat-run on this head in a detached worktree: `--self-test` exit 0 — 544 cases across 18 batteries (530 on `origin/main`, +14, none removed); the seat's own offline probes through `classifyReadBack` on this head: today's pair → `footer-blank-collapsed`, landed; the collapse alone → landed; a content byte differing → `mutated`, not landed; two extra blank lines → `mutated`; identical → identical. `merge-tree` vs `origin/main` `8e368dc`: 0 conflicts; CI on `8cc37b7`: 34 check runs, 2 still running, 0 red. The dev's ablation (the `strippedNewlines === 0` guard re-added on disk → 9 of 544 red, all among the 14 added; blob restored and proven), the three FILED stored byte counts (#19343 3585, #19360 2892, #19404 4623) pinned as the transformation's own arithmetic, the 30-family derived union 30 / 30 exit 0 with `--ran` reconciled, repo-wide `pnpm lint` exit 0, `check:pm-dispatch-gates` exit 0 (foreground, 16 min).
